stories.headline: CFTC Charges Cash FX Group Over $950M Forex Scheme
stories.summary: Regulators allege the group and three individuals ran a fraud causing at least $406 million in investor losses.
stories.originalTitle: CFTC Sues Cash FX Over Alleged $950M Forex Ponzi Scheme

stories.headline: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292 Million Exploit
stories.summary: Evercrest Technologies filed a lawsuit in British Columbia against LayerZero and its CEO over an April rsETH exploit.
stories.originalTitle: KelpDAO Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit

stories.headline: Ethena adds tokenized stocks to stablecoin collateral pool
stories.summary: The protocol expanded its backing strategy to include equity perpetuals and tokenized stocks on a major cryptocurrency exchange.
stories.event_rationale: This is a direct protocol update for a major stablecoin, distinct from previous news about USDC or tokenized stock redemptions.
stories.originalTitle: Ethena expands USDe backing strategy into bStocks and equity perpetuals on Binance

stories.headline: Solana Foundation hires new strategy and payments executives
stories.summary: Rachel Conlan joins as chief strategy officer, while Jamal Raees becomes general manager of payments.
stories.originalTitle: Solana Foundation appoints Rachel Conlan and Jamal Raees to strategy and payments roles

stories.headline: Researchers Develop Quantum Resistance Strategies for Bitcoin
stories.summary: Recent developments in cost, privacy, and custody show researchers preparing Bitcoin for potential quantum computing threats.
stories.originalTitle: Bitcoin's Quantum Problem: Three Ways Researchers Are Trying to Fix It

stories.headline: Vitalik Buterin Details Ethereum Architecture Goals Through 2030
stories.summary: The network's co-founder explained proposed technical changes aimed at expanding functionality over the coming decade.
stories.originalTitle: ‘It’s really not just a blockchain anymore’: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s path to 2030

stories.headline: California Bans Public Officials From Creating Memecoins
stories.summary: Governor Newsom signed legislation restricting California officials and crypto platforms from offering official-linked tokens starting in 2027.
stories.originalTitle: California Bars Public Officials From Issuing Memecoins

stories.headline: Riot Repays $200 Million Coinbase Loan, Releasing Collateral
stories.summary: On September 21, the bitcoin miner cleared its debt, recovering its custody-held bitcoin, USDC, and cash collateral.
stories.originalTitle: Riot Platforms Repays $200M Coinbase Loan and Frees Collateral

stories.headline: THORChain Rejects Bitget Request to Block Hacker Wallets
stories.summary: The protocol maintained its permissionless status by refusing to blacklist addresses linked to a September 24 theft.
stories.originalTitle: THORChain Refuses Bitget Plea to Block Hacker Wallets
